newsitem.title: FALKLAND ISLANDS: Falkland islanders get Xmas gift from Argentina.
newsitem.headline: Falkland islanders get Xmas gift from Argentina.

text.p: Residents on the British-ruled Falklands Islands said on Thursday they had received Christmas presents from Argentina's Foreign Minister Guido di Tella in what has become a seasonal tradition.
Di Tella sent Antoine de Saint-Exupery's book "The Little Prince" to many of the 850 households on the islands accompanied by a letter spelling out the reason for his choice.

"I have picked a delightful little book that the author says was written for grown-ups full of imagination and dreams, who were children not so long ago. I hope you will enjoy reading it as much as I have enjoyed it myself," he said in the letter.
Argentina lays claim to the islands in the south Atlantic and fought a war over them with Britain in 1982.

It is the fourth year in succession di Tella has sent a gift to the Falklands. Last year he sent a photograph of his grandchildren and the year before a video cassette of a popular British television series "Pingu the Penguin".
